name: py-normalize-path
instruction: Implement normalize_path.py: def normalize_path(p: str) -> str. Collapse '.' and '..' segments and duplicate slashes in a POSIX path. An ABSOLUTE path can never escape the root: '/a/../..' is '/'. A RELATIVE path keeps leading '..' that cannot be resolved: 'a/../../b' is '../b'. Preserve a trailing slash ONLY for the root. normalize_path('') is '.'. Do not use os.path or posixpath.
gateCmd: python3 -c "from normalize_path import normalize_path as n; assert n('/a/b/../c')=='/a/c'; print('gate ok')"
verifyCmd:
python3 -c "from normalize_path import normalize_path as n
assert n('/a/b/../c')=='/a/c', n('/a/b/../c')
assert n('/a/../..')=='/', n('/a/../..')
assert n('a/../../b')=='../b', n('a/../../b')
assert n('')=='.', n('')
assert n('//a///b')=='/a/b', n('//a///b')
assert n('/')=='/', n('/')
assert n('./a/./b')=='a/b', n('./a/./b')
assert n('a/b/')=='a/b', n('a/b/')
print('ok')"
